verdict.rationale: Kong documents exporting OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics for generative AI, MCP and A2A traffic through an OpenTelemetry AI Policy. It also says logs and metrics can be analyzed in Konnect or any OpenTelemetry tool, and it describes a standardized AI log format covering payloads, tokens, latency and cost. That covers the core of sending gateway telemetry to your own stack. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of distributed trace (span) export, detail on log-shipping destinations or formats beyond the local error.log, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
